name: Move's entry next to Jellyfin Enhanced, in the je sandbox: Jellyfin Enhanced's Remove from Continue Watching and Move's entry in one sheet, and Move's dialog opening from it

steps.name: the helpers (a log of Library Maintenance's requests, short names)
home page, Library Maintenance's script and its capabilities
a resume position on one movie (40% in), so it is on Continue Watching
steps.script: const u = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const items = (await ApiClient.getItems(u, { Recursive: true, IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', SortBy: 'SortName', Fields: 'MediaSources' })).Items.filter(m => m.RunTimeTicks > 0); const m = items[0]; await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('UserItems/' + m.Id + '/UserData', { userId: u }), data: JSON.stringify({ PlaybackPositionTicks: Math.round(m.RunTimeTicks * 0.4), Played: false }), contentType: 'application/json' }); const resume = (await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'GET', url: ApiClient.getUrl('UserItems/Resume', { userId: u, MediaTypes: 'Video' }), dataType: 'json' })).Items.map(i => i.Id); return { id: m.Id, name: m.Name, inResume: resume.indexOf(m.Id) >= 0 };

steps.name: the movie's card in the Continue Watching row

steps.script: const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.homePage:not(.hide) .verticalSection')].find(x => /Continue Watching/i.test((x.querySelector('.sectionTitle') || {}).textContent || '')); const c = s.querySelector('.card[data-id="' + __vars.resumed.id + '"]'); c.setAttribute('data-lmm-target', 'resume'); return c.getAttribute('data-id');

steps.name: 9. a real click on the card's menu button (Jellyfin Enhanced records its trigger on mousedown, the kit on click)
9. both entries in the sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const rows = __lmm.rows(); const core = ['resume','play','playallfromhere','multiSelect','addtocollection','addtoplaylist','download','copy-stream','delete','edit','editimages','editsubtitles','identify','moremediainfo','refresh','markplayed','markunplayed','share','queue','queueallfromhere','shuffle','instantmix','playlist']; return { rows: rows, others: rows.filter(id => core.indexOf(id) < 0 && id.indexOf('jflm-') !== 0), ours: __lmm.ours() }; })()
